scope: Exploratory feasibility search in the complete two-state edge-emitting parameterization, targeted at the frozen one-bit tradeoff point; no optimizer optimum is a theorem
parameterization: Two four-entry stochastic rows, each three stick-breaking coordinates; one initial-mixture coordinate. Seven coordinates cover the full two-state edge-emitting family, including its boundary.
objective: Minimize E[A/N] under coverage>=the exact feedback coverage and E|S|<=the exact feedback imbalance. A fixed penalty is only a numerical search aid; rational feasibility decides any claim.
verification: Retain exact rational law and Bellman residual certificate for any feasible improvement. No Monte Carlo packing runs or p-values. Store unsuccessful searches too.
